title: Fantasy Adventures+
description: A fantasy themed modpack with a modern Fabric feel
body:
This modpack offers a modern feel to the fantasy genre by offering loads of content to explore while remaining on Fabric. You can find some of the highlight features of the modpack below.

- 🌍 Dozens of new biomes via Region's Unexplored
- 🛠️ A massive skill path to unlock and build your class from
- 🎒 Quality-of-life improvements like inventory sorting and nature ambience
- ⚔️ Tons of new armor sets and weapons to craft and collect
- ✨ New animations for the player and mobs
- 🌀 New dimensions to explore via Deeper and Darker

FAQ:

How do I improve performance when playing this modpack?

- Reducing shader quality settings or outright disabling shaders can help immensely, or disabling Distant Horizon rendering. FA+ is a fairly lightweight modpack besides these two features, which are both clientsided meaning you can disable them if it is too taxing on your computer.

Is there a server-sided only version of this modpack that I can use for my server?

- No, this is intended to be a singleplayer experience for the time being.

My camera is floaty, how do I fix this?

- You probably hit Y, which is the default key for cinematic camera

How do I toggle the first person model off/how do I go into third person mode?

- F6 and X, respectively
